record.label: SUB-6: phase-2 virgin gate (6 fresh 1024x16 nets) + fire protocol for the two-table + refit candidates
record.summary: Fresh nets 3016500-3016505 with weights, 4M MPS truth and the deployed card's baseline (host+F2J MSE 1.89-4.10e-8, mean 2.71e-8 ~ the board's 2.94e-8; lineage check BASE == estimator_cap.py to 1e-5). Harness run_virgin_gate_p2.py <cand.py> <seeds> (venv; BudgetContext 2^41; paired cut vs deployed, bill). Fire pre-authorized by Matt (2026-09-02) after: 8-net panel under independent truths, virgin gate, adjusted-score check, meaningful bar or the ~1.5e-8 bank line; ledger entry; 10/day. 2026-09-03: gate ready; no candidate beats the board (round-1 candidate valid but worse); nothing fired. 2026-09-03 04:00: no candidate reached the gate; nothing fired; board 2.94e-8 unchanged.
record.terminal_criterion: Closed when a candidate passes panel + virgin gate + bill and is graded on the board.
record.goal_path_summary: Six brand-new networks the estimator has never seen, with ground truth, so any candidate is checked for real generalization before it is submitted.
